messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Unlike fish and bugs,
fossils can't run away{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}So
why can't I find any, then?
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kaladest ja putukatest
erinevalt ei jookse{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Miks
ma neid siis ei leia?

messages.en:
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Fossils have millions of
years of experience hiding.

They're like ninjas or
something. {01 01 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It won't be so
easy to find them.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Fossiilidel on miljoneid
aastaid peitmiskogemust.

Nad on nagu nindžad
või midagi. {01 01 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Neid ei ole
nii lihtne leida.

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}Where is it?{01 00 00 14 00} All I want is a
fossil that's as small and
pretty as I am!
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}Kus see on?{01 00 00 14 00} Ma tahan ainult
fossiili, mis on sama väike
ja ilus kui mina!
